notes.title: 🌿 [Hero’s Odyssey Update] – v0.3.0 – Polish Voice Acting is LIVE! 🌿
notes.notes:
Hey Traveler! We’ve got something really special to share today!
Hero’s Odyssey now features full Polish voice acting in the demo!

This is a major milestone for our team - for the first time ever, you can experience the world of Hero’s Odyssey in our native language. Hearing our characters speak Polish has been an emotional and unforgettable moment, and we hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we did creating it. 💖

Haven’t seen it yet? The brand-new Polish trailer dropped on Monday - check it out for a first taste of the dub experience!
[previewyoutube=j7SKEMBE-QE;full][/previewyoutube]

Download the updated demo, give it a spin, and let us know what you think!
Your feedback means the world to us - especially as we work on making the game more accessible to players in multiple languages. 

👇 Drop your thoughts below and stay tuned - this is just the beginning!
Sweet Sennin Games Team

notes.title: 🌿 [Hero’s Odyssey Update] – v0.2.0 🌿

[h3]🌍 What’s New?
[/h3][b][Added][/b]
[list]
[*] New Pythia CG
[*] Adjusted existing CG style (we basically redrew all existing CG in the demo)
[*] NEW Angry Kallias sprite—better not mess with him!
[*] More SFX!
[*] More save slots!
[/list]

[b][FIX]

[/list]

notes.title: 🌿 [Hero's Odyssey Update] - v0.1.2 🌿
notes.notes:
[b]🌍 What’s New?
[/b][b]Spanish Localization is here![/b] 🎉🎉🎉 ->Now you can experience the game in Spanish!
[b]Polish Localization Fixes [/b] -> We’ve patched up missing dialogues and tweaked text size & declension.

🔧[b]Why a Smaller Update?[/b]
We’re in the middle of updating Unity and Naninovel, so right now, our hands are kinda tied. 😅 Fingers crossed that everything goes smoothly and nothing catches fire! 

🐛 [b]We Hear You![/b]
We know some bugs are still lurking, and we really appreciate you reporting them. Thank you for your patience! ❤️ Once our big engine updates are done, we’ll be tackling those fixes next.

Thanks for sticking with us - your support keeps this odyssey going! 💫

notes.title: [UPDATE] - New Content - v1.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]INTRODUCTION[/b]  
In celebration of the upcoming festival, we’re introducing special content that reveals further story arcs and new companions.

[b]ADDED:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] An additional storyline that sheds some light on our future female companions.  
[*] A new, dynamic rooftop intro—less filler, more action, and more visually appealing scenes.  
[*] A new story choice—yes, this is the moment to try defying Zeus… if you dare!  
[*] 10 new achievements!
[/list]

[b]FIXES:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Script adjustments—repetitive and dull descriptions have been removed.  
[*] Enhanced CG—minor visual errors have been fixed, ensuring nothing disrupts epic moments.  
[*] Zeus is no longer Voldemort—sprites for Zeus and Vespera have been refined.  
[/list]

[b]Many of you are asking about the game’s price,[/b] so the planned price is 8.49 USD.

[b]PLANS FOR THE FUTURE[/b]  
We’re working hard on the upcoming chapters and further development of the main storyline.  
Thank you for your feedback and support!  
Starting today, we promise to keep you regularly informed about our progress.
